source: Restaurants, bars and attractions from Visit Santa Barbara (santabarbaraca.com) listings and official museum/zoo sites (Nov 2026); refreshed with the weekly update

spots.name: Santa Barbara Zoo
spots.blurb: Zoo near East Beach, open daily 9:30am–4pm during IllumaNature season
spots.blurbEs: Zoológico cerca de East Beach, abierto a diario de 9:30 a.m. a 4 p.m. durante la temporada de IllumaNature

spots.name: Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History
spots.blurb: Natural history galleries in Mission Canyon, open daily 10am–5pm
spots.blurbEs: Galerías de historia natural en Mission Canyon, abiertas a diario de 10 a.m. a 5 p.m.

spots.name: Santa Barbara Museum of Art
spots.blurb: Downtown art museum on State Street, open Tuesday–Sunday
spots.blurbEs: Museo de arte del centro, en State Street, abierto de martes a domingo

spots.name: Santa Barbara Botanic Garden
spots.blurb: California native plant garden, open daily 10am–5pm; reservations required
spots.blurbEs: Jardín de plantas nativas de California, abierto a diario de 10 a.m. a 5 p.m.; se requiere reservación

spots.name: Stearns Wharf
spots.blurb: California's oldest working wooden wharf, with ocean and mountain views
spots.blurbEs: El muelle de madera en uso más antiguo de California, con vistas al mar y a las montañas
